name: Winter Orb Elementalist
summary: Winter Orb is a channel-and-run cold skill: hold the button until the orb is charged, then move while it keeps firing. The Elementalist shell adds chill, exposure and a lightning-free damage package, so the build maps with almost no aiming and no required unique.

pros.text: Damage continues while you move, so dodging costs little uptime.
Chill and freeze make packs and boss adds much less dangerous.
No required unique; spell damage and gem levels carry the build.
The cold package leaves the gear slots free for life and resistances.
A strong visual contrast to the usual self-cast projectile builds.
The same spell gear can pivot to another cold spell later.

cons.text: Channeling the orb roots you for the first moment of every pack.
Single-target is a sustained channel, not a burst window.
Cold-resistant bosses slow the fight noticeably.
Mana is tight until reduced cost and regeneration are online.
Elemental reflect maps are a hard no.

Winter Orb.description: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration.

summary.text: Winter Orb Elementalist channels a floating orb that keeps firing while you move. It measures 44.5k at red maps and 59.8k at pinnacle, and needs no unique.

leveling.text: Level with Freezing Pulse, then switch to Winter Orb as soon as it is available. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 73 damage; the second measures 698.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 44.5k damage, 36391 effective life and 12520 physical max hit. Charge the orb for a moment, then move through the pack while it fires.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 59.8k damage with 50921 effective life and 13800 physical max hit. Keep the orb charged, apply exposure, and move out of the slam instead of holding the channel.
